cells: Variation in genes within a species. Higher genetic diversity improves resilience to diseases and climate change.
Variety and relative abundance of species in a region. Includes species richness and species evenness.
Variety of habitats such as forests, deserts, wetlands, grasslands, and marine ecosystems.

blocks.content: Biodiversity refers to the sum total of diversity that exists at all levels of biological organization.

rows: Variation of genes within a single species
Potency of reserpine in Rauwolfia vomitoria
Variety of species within a region or habitat
Greater amphibian species in Western Ghats
Variety of ecosystems within a geographical area
India's combination of deserts, rainforests, and mangroves

items: Sociobiologist Edward Wilson popularized the term 'biodiversity' to describe combined diversity across all biological levels.
The Western Ghats exhibit greater amphibian species diversity compared to the Eastern Ghats.
Differentiate clearly between Alpha (within community), Beta (between communities), and Gamma (regional) diversity for direct MCQs.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Genetic diversity refers to variations of genes within a single species, enabling adaptation to changing environments.
Species diversity represents the variety and abundance of species within a specific habitat or region.
Ecological diversity includes the variety of ecosystems such as deserts, rainforests, mangroves, and coral reefs.
R.H. Whittaker classified ecosystem diversity into Alpha (local), Beta (between habitats), and Gamma (regional) diversity.
